ValidationRule.description: No editing should be allowed when stage is cancelled
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, ApplicationForm.Opportunity.RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Commercial_Opportunity', $User.Profile_Name__c = 'ANZ CCRM Standard User', $UserRole.DeveloperName <> 'Commercial_Admin', AND ( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Stage), 'Cancelled'), ISCHANGED(Stage) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot re-open this AFP as it has already been marked as Cancelled. Please re-launch your product(s).
